title: Simultaneous parameter-root algebra
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, let $p,n\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$, and let $a:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to A$. Using the multivariate polynomial ring [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], define the simultaneous root algebra to be the commutative $A$-algebra $$A[X_i:i<n]/(X_i^p-a_i:i<n),$$ with the coefficient map induced by constant polynomials. No primality, characteristic, locality or invertibility assumption is part of this definition. The empty family and exponent zero are allowed.
